title: openagents worktree ls|archive|restore
body:
P2.1: list task worktrees with task state, size, dirty/unpushed, age; archive uses git::removable (or --force with typed confirmation); restore recreates detached at the recorded commit (record from #10291).

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec).
